status: PROVISIONAL inputs for research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py. Owner decisions D1 (hardware reference), D4 (propeller variant) and D5 (engine) are open; the values below are the F4U plan's recommended defaults and change only here. Nothing in this file is measured on a built 1/5 Corsair.

decisions.D1_hardware_reference: FokkeRC Vought F4U-1D Corsair 1/5 (recommended, not yet selected by the owner)
decisions.D4_propeller: three-blade (F4U-1D airframe); the four-blade belongs to the F4U-4

kit.name: FokkeRC Vought F4U-1D Corsair 1/5

flying_mass_kg.source: no published FokkeRC flying mass; F4U-01 mass inference: TopRC 93 in (16.8 kg) and Seagull 87 in (13.6 kg) scaled to 2.50 m span give 17.4-18.8 kg (span^2) and 19.7-19.9 kg (span^3); target near the middle, range widened (docs/research/f4u-corsair/F4U-01/README.md)

reference_setup.name: Phoenix Model F4U Corsair 1.8 m (PMMA1845), electric
reference_setup.note: Manual page 1 specification block: CG 110 mm back from the wing leading edge at the fuselage; throws up/down (rudder right/left) in mm; flaps down. The measuring station is not stated: angles use the surface chord at its inboard end. length_ratio_to_1_5 = 2.5 m / 1.8 m: the Phoenix is 1/6.94 scale, so its lengths scale by 1.389 to this 1/5 airframe.

engine.name: DLE-111 (111.2 cc twin, two-stroke gasoline)
engine.sources: 11.2 hp / 7500 rpm, idle 1400 rpm, recommended 27x10 26x12 28x10: DLE-111 manual (mikrocontroller.net/attachment/566025/dle_111_eng.pdf, mirrored; not retrieved in full) as repeated by MacGregor (macgregor.co.uk/dleengine/dle111.htm) and Lindinger (lindinger.at, item 78867); 2370 g engine and 2690 g total: Lindinger technical data; 25.5 kgf static at 100 m altitude: distributor claim (fridayparts.com), propeller not named

propeller.name: Mejzlik 26x12 3-blade GAS N
propeller.source: DLE-111 recommended 26x12; three blades match the F4U-1D (D4). Manufacturer table and mass in research/p51/p51-06/mejzlik_26x12.json (datasheet hash recorded there)

retracts.main: Robart #150 rotating pneumatic (90 degree wheel twist)
retracts.source: FokkeRC kit specification (units); cycle time estimated as the P-51's pneumatic sequencer value, no Robart timing published

kit.cg_fraction_note: The CG comes from the Phoenix reference setup, scaled; the derivation reports it in % MAC.

full_size.sources: NACA RM A7C05 (F4U-4 flying qualities, 1947, ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20050081862) dimension table and summary; NACA WR L-440 (1/2.75 model, 1942, ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19930093637); wing area: Patriots Point FG-1D and WR L-440 model area x 2.75^2. OCR-degraded values are recorded in docs/research/f4u-corsair/F4U-01/README.md

sections.method: XFOIL 6.96 predictions, Ncrit 9, free transition, via airfoiltools.com (polar ids xf-naca230xx-il-{500000,1000000}); 23009 is not hosted, so 23012 stands for the thin outer sections. Reduced over alpha -2..6 deg (slope, zero-lift angle) and CL 0-0.6 (moment).

xfoil_corrections.source: estimated: XFOIL's free-transition predictions run above wind-tunnel lift slope and maximum lift for real model surfaces; the P-51 derivation subtracts 0.05 from measured TN 1945 data for a painted finish, doubled here for XFOIL optimism. Abbott and von Doenhoff list about 0.10-0.105/deg for 230-series sections at high Reynolds number
